textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 10 social-science · Political Science 2: Federalism · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Federalism is a system of government in which power is divided between a central authority and the various units of the country, each with its own powers.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Federalism is a system of government in which power is divided between a central authority and the various units of the country, each with its own powers.
beats.speakEn: Federalism is a system of government in which power is divided between a central authority and the various units of the country, each with its own powers.

beats.en: A federation has two levels of government that govern the same citizens and have separate jurisdiction, and the Constitution cannot be changed by one level alone.
beats.speakEn: A federation has two levels of government that govern the same citizens and have separate jurisdiction, and the Constitution cannot be changed by one level alone.
